vision: Lowest total cost of CORRECT completion via immutable evidence, Jev/System-1 selective context, cache-aware routing and fail-closed multi-agent governance.

epics.title: Context Pruning v2 — safe, incremental, cache-aware projections
Context Intelligence Fabric — shared memory, caching and cost-aware model routing

records.title: Canonical tool outcome and failure semantics
records.description: Extend exact-read selectors into an explicit success/failure/pending result taxonomy without confusing error messages with authorization or semantics.
acceptance: Typed outcomes distinguish success, terminal failure, retryable failure and unresolved operation.
Normalization is backward-compatible with Pi/OpenCode/OpenAI and fail-closed for ambiguous custom tools.

records.title: Build per-harness tool outcome adapters
records.description: Normalize tool call ID, arguments, status, stdout/stderr, error code, redaction, provenance and timestamps across supported hosts.
acceptance: Fixtures verify all supported formats, missing status and counterfeit success flags.

records.title: Implement failure condensation preserving actionable errors
records.description: Convert noisy failed call sequences to precise failure facts (permission denied, missing resource, invalid arguments, network timeout) with links to originals.
acceptance: Same failure repeated ten times retains cause and retry guidance once; non-equivalent failures are not conflated.

records.title: Classify retryable, terminal, resolved and pending failures
records.description: Track whether a failure was superseded by success, left unresolved, or signals important constraints; don't assume success erases prior evidence.
acceptance: Regression cases protect auth errors, security denials, partial writes and unfinished jobs; insignificant retries can be omitted from views.

records.title: Provenance-safe semantic/line-span pruning
records.description: Move beyond byte-identical files to selectively retaining relevant spans with reversible, source-linked witnesses and deterministic protected categories.
acceptance: Every projected segment has a stable source range and proof; exact original is recoverable.
No protected instruction, constraint, citation, decision or unresolved dependency can be silently dropped.

records.title: Define canonical segment IDs and source-span receipts
records.description: Represent message and line/paragraph ranges, content hashes, source versions and redacted audit metadata for targeted projections.
acceptance: Round-trip restores exact canonical content and rejects stale hashes, changed tool content and overlapping projections.

records.title: Implement protected evidence and dependency graph
records.description: Pin user/developer/system constraints, decisions, citations, security evidence, unresolved actions and prerequisites before selecting candidates.
acceptance: Synthetic counterexamples preserve unique causal links and requirements even when a model rates them low relevance.

records.title: Add bounded semantic pruning with Jev and escalation
records.description: Expose replaceable evaluator interface, local deterministic prefilters, abstain/escalate logic and no-op fallback for uncertain predictions.
acceptance: Only approved, provenance-backed spans are projected; evaluator uncertainty, parse failure or timeout preserves originals.

records.title: Incremental context curation and cost-bounded evaluation
records.description: Avoid repeatedly rereading the entire context on every turn by updating relevance against deltas and snapshots while bounding evaluator overhead.
acceptance: Unchanged inputs reuse verified decisions; changes invalidate only affected proofs.
Optimization stops when expected savings do not exceed assessment cost and quality-risk budget.

records.title: Build change-stream relevance index
records.description: Process new messages/tool events incrementally, preserving dependency versioning and protected tail limits.
acceptance: Repeated no-op turn yields no paid assessment; edits to dependency invalidate affected segments only.

records.title: Implement versioned state and safe receipt migration
records.description: Persist revisioned pruning decisions and restart/fork-safe projection state with conflict detection.
acceptance: Crash/restart/fork tests never apply another session's receipts, including after model changes.

records.title: Implement configurable Jev budget, threshold and escalation policy
records.description: Expose evaluator costs, rate limits, batching, privacy/residency controls and optional stronger-model review.
acceptance: No hidden paid requests; spending cap, dry run, abort, backpressure and refusal are tested.

records.title: Real host scheduler and token budget parity
records.description: Promote reference decision gate to verified native integrations with authoritative next-request token counts, resumability and native compaction isolation.
acceptance: A successful prune changes actual model input and can resume safely when host contracts allow.
Host capability matrix distinguishes tested runtime/version from experimental or unsupported integrations.

records.title: Implement model-aware next-inference token budgeting
records.description: Count full rendered request with proper tokenizer, tool schema, attachments, reserved output and uncertainty margin; report unknown when unsupported.
acceptance: Hard context limits tested for multiple models and host formats; no byte-derived READY decision.

records.title: Implement native Prune/Compact/Pause lifecycle and CAS
records.description: Wire Gate state machine to supported native scheduler boundaries, protect pending tasks, explicit approval and revision conflict checks.
acceptance: Prune never silently invokes compact; canceled/stale selection cannot resume or mutate another request.

records.title: Validate real Pi, OpenCode and Hermes request projections
records.description: Test adapter loading, host-version negotiation, live-model request interception, single-user Hermes guard and platform restart behavior.
acceptance: Evidence captures actual outbound request and no-op paths; unsupported hosts never claim live pruning.

records.title: Cache-aware pruning decision contracts
records.description: Optimize whether to prune only after comparing token reduction to provider prompt-prefix reuse and router/model selection costs.
acceptance: Existing cache hits are not invalidated by default for marginal token savings.
Versioned adapter contract exchanges candidate context hashes and measurable cost estimates without passing sensitive source bytes.

records.title: Represent prompt-cache prefix stability and invalidation
records.description: Report exact prefix hash, provider/model cache scope, TTL/eligibility and whether transformation breaks native cache.
acceptance: Tests show changed early message invalidates affected prefixes and unchanged suffixes are not counted as guaranteed hits.

records.title: Compare unpruned, pruned and routed context plans
records.description: Estimate cost/latency/risk using real cache discounts, evaluator overhead, retries and quality floor; allow forced no-op.
acceptance: Scenario tests select cached longer prefix when cheaper, even if pruning reduces raw tokens.

records.title: Version jev-bus context-projection and cache telemetry contract
records.description: Publish interoperable schema including claim scope, tenant/session, source receipts, projection/cost metadata and error behavior.
acceptance: Cross-project contract suite rejects conflicting claim owners, unknown versions and untrusted caller mutations.

records.title: Security boundaries, rollback and auditability
records.description: Strengthen safety around untrusted context, secrets, tool results, cross-session scope and reversible decision provenance.
acceptance: No tool result can inject evaluator policy or authorize pruning.
Auditors can explain why a span was kept/omitted and restore original active context without deleting history.

records.title: Document adversarial pruning threat model
records.description: Address prompt injection, poisoned source, redaction escape, auth-denial removal, hallucinated success and compromised evaluator.
acceptance: Negative fixtures exercise each threat; mitigation matrix names residual risks.

records.title: Enforce tenant/workspace/session policy before projections
records.description: Require trusted scope binding, principal authorization and strict non-merge semantics for multi-agent/shared instances.
acceptance: Cross-tenant and reused session ID attacks cannot read or prune each other's records.

records.title: Harden audit proofs, approval and rollback lifecycle
records.description: Store reason codes, canonical hashes, proof graph, applied-view revisions and explicit restore while keeping source immutable.
acceptance: Concurrency and stale proof tests fail closed; audit output never leaks credential-bearing content.

records.title: Benchmarking, reliability and release-readiness
records.description: Prove actual task and cost improvement over baseline under realistic models, hosts, cache configurations and adversarial cases.
acceptance: Report task success, token costs, cache hits, retries and latency with confidence intervals.
Do not declare production readiness using only synthetic byte counts or mocked hosts.

records.title: Build reproducible pruning benchmark harness
records.description: Include long coding sessions, repeated reads, failed tools, search/research agents, huge context and multi-model caches.
acceptance: Comparisons use identical tasks and model settings; results include unmodified and no-op baselines.

records.title: Test retention quality, regression and adversarial suites
records.description: Score constraint recall, citation correctness, error diagnosis, end-task success and unsafe omission rates.
acceptance: Known critical failures cause a release blocker; publish raw fixtures and per-case traces.

records.title: Measure robustness and publish a verified deployment matrix
records.description: Exercise concurrency, cancellation, replay, fork, WSL/Linux/Windows/macOS and provider cache interactions.
acceptance: Release notes distinguish tested vs experimental behavior and measured vs modeled savings.

records.title: Canonical evidence governance and isolation
records.description: Harden source-backed store, typed role signals and lineage to support safe multi-agent and cross-session reuse.
acceptance: All derived views link to immutable or revision-tracked evidence and tenant/workspace/session scope.
Evidence can be superseded without deleting historical truth and is never treated as authority.

records.title: Add append-only provenance and semantic event schema
records.description: Capture observation/fact/claim/decision/constraint/attempt/failure/success, parent IDs, hashes, timestamps, author and status.
acceptance: Replay reconstructs lifecycle with citations; later correction preserves earlier evidence.

records.title: Implement principal/tenant isolation and cross-agent sharing policy
records.description: Replace sole worktree-based trust with explicit authorization for source access, hydration, write operations and scoped shared caches.
acceptance: Identical worktree path for different principals does not cross-leak; deny rules tested for MCP/HTTP/bridge.

records.title: Add derived evidence invalidation and conflict resolution
records.description: Track source revisions, file changes, branch divergence, staleness and conflicting facts without claiming a hash means truth.
acceptance: Changed source invalidates dependent retrieval features and context views; replay restores exact supported state.

records.title: Task-aware context assembly and retrieval
records.description: Assemble tailored, auditable per-model context using constraints, evidence, reusable blocks and incremental state, avoiding whole-history reprocessing.
acceptance: Generated context package meets a real tokenizer budget including tool schemas and output reserves.
Reasons for inclusion/exclusion and source references are inspectable and reversible.

records.title: Introduce model/agent/task context profiles and real tokenizers
records.description: Support context length, output reserve, tool budgets, ordering, pinned constraints and per-provider cache-prefix requirements.
acceptance: Different target models receive correctly sized bundles; unknown tokenizer uses safe fallback.

records.title: Add provenance-first retrieval with citations and page faults
records.description: Expand FTS/BM25 and typed relation retrieval with source range, rerank explanation and hydration on demand.
acceptance: Question-answer benchmarks measure recall of critical constraints and evidence, not just character reduction.

records.title: Make context assembly incremental and revision aware
records.description: Reevaluate only changed/new evidence and task state, with stable block IDs, dedup and budgeted partial hydration.
acceptance: Unchanged turns skip remote evaluator; mid-task corrections invalidate affected blocks without erasing audit history.

records.title: Shared context and response cache stack
records.description: Provide composable caches for reusable evidence/context and safe exact/semantic responses above any provider, with scope-checked keys and controlled TTLs.
acceptance: Cache keys bind task, model/provider relevant parameters, source versions, policy and principal scope.
No unsafe semantic substitution for tool execution, security answers or time-sensitive facts.

records.title: Implement exact deterministic response cache interface
records.description: Add Redis/Valkey/local backends, canonical request hashing, TTL/eviction, secret-safe keying and cache provenance.
acceptance: Responses match all correctness-affecting parameters; streaming/tool side effects are never replayed as if executed.

records.title: Implement optional semantic response cache with safety gates
records.description: Define embedding/rerank adapters, similarity calibration, freshness invalidation, low-risk eligibility and model/task overrides.
acceptance: Counterexamples reject falsely similar prompts, personalized/secret and stale answers; exact-cache fallback supported.

records.title: Implement shared reusable evidence/context-block cache
records.description: Cache verified source references, excerpts, typed classifications, content fingerprints and access restrictions across agents.
acceptance: Authorized agents reuse blocks without recomputation; changes and permission revocations invalidate affected entries.

records.title: Provider-native prefix caches and compatible local KV reuse
records.description: Maximize prompt prefix reuse while explicitly separating reusable text/context from vendor- and model-specific internal KV caches.
acceptance: Anthropic-style cache breakpoints and OpenAI/Gemini cache hints are capability-aware, not treated as universal semantics.
An optional local-KV adapter may share compatible self-hosted model caches only with matching model/runtime/configuration.

records.title: Implement provider-aware prompt cache planner
records.description: Version provider capability registry, TTL/breakpoints, stable prompt ordering, creation/reads and eligibility; measure cache hit evidence.
acceptance: Unit tests prove unsupported providers do not receive fabricated cache controls, and edited prefixes invalidate native cache.

records.title: Evaluate optional LMCache/vLLM-style compatible KV layer
records.description: Define pluggable adapter for model/version/tokenizer-compatible KV sharing with memory pressure and security controls.
acceptance: Interop tests prove incompatible models/tokenizers never reuse KV; feature off by default for hosted providers.

records.title: Track cache lineage, expiry, freshness and economics
records.description: Record observed cache-read/write tokens and estimated break-even, invalidation, warm-up and fallback; expose explain decisions.
acceptance: Telemetry distinguishes hit, miss, ineligible and unknown; no model-agnostic provider KV reuse claims.

records.title: Pluggable intelligent routing and gateway integration
records.description: Connect to LiteLLM/Bifrost/OpenAI-compatible gateways and optional RouteLLM-style policies, selecting an execution path based on quality, effective cost, context fit and cache.
acceptance: No vendor lock-in; failover path respects data residency, rate limits and budget ceilings.
Router explains selection, can pin a model, and reports actual billable usage.

records.title: Create gateway adapter contracts with LiteLLM and Bifrost reference implementations
records.description: Normalize model catalog, health, rate limits, pricing, caching support, tool calling, auth and tenancy; support mock/offline mode.
acceptance: Simulated gateway swap preserves task semantics; feature/capability detection fails safely.

records.title: Integrate RouteLLM-style task complexity and model suitability policy
records.description: Evaluate simple vs hard tasks using replaceable classifier, model performance priors, risk constraints and uncertainty escalation.
acceptance: Benchmark shows classification overhead does not exceed savings; allow a fixed-route baseline.

records.title: Implement cache-, cost-, reliability- and quality-aware planner
records.description: Optimize expected total task cost including input/output token discounts, latency, failure/retry probability, context preparation and tool costs.
acceptance: Scenario replay shows cached expensive model beating uncached cheaper model when effective cost is lower; quality floors hold.

records.title: Agentic tool routing and adaptive memory feedback
records.description: Route jobs to models and tools using task constraints, completed tool outcomes, available context and durable feedback without overfitting opaque model grades.
acceptance: Actions and tools are never authorized by retrieved content.
Successful paths become reusable evidence while failure causes remain retrievable.

records.title: Define agent task contracts and tool capability routing
records.description: Represent permissioned tools, job risk, latency/cost ceilings, required modalities and output validity checks.
acceptance: Router refuses unauthorized tool/model combinations and can reroute after measured failure.

records.title: Store verified outcomes and feedback loops
records.description: Record downstream task success, retry, test pass/fail, user correction and evidence quality for later ranking.
acceptance: Unverified model self-grading never becomes ground truth; feedback lineage and opt-out supported.

records.title: Implement context-fault detection and on-demand rehydration
records.description: Expose explicit missing-context signals and bounded source hydration to restore critical facts during execution.
acceptance: A model recovers omitted citation or constraint without full transcript replay; permission-denied faults remain denied.

records.title: Cost, quality and cache-economics evaluation program
records.description: Build task-level controlled experiments measuring correct outcomes rather than isolated inference token reduction.
acceptance: Benchmark compares naive baseline, static compaction, pruning only, cache only and combined adaptive optimization.
Report actual cost, quality and latency with per-provider breakdown and uncertainty.

records.title: Build replayable end-to-end benchmark dataset
records.description: Use coding, research, long contexts, repeated tools, failures, prompt injection and cross-agent tasks with gold outcome checks.
acceptance: Fixture suite covers cache-hit, cache-miss and changed-context cases; reproduce results from pinned versions.

records.title: Collect usage, pricing, token and cache telemetry
records.description: Normalize provider token accounting and prices, model metadata, tool calls, Jev assessor overhead and end-task cost.
acceptance: Conservation tests reconcile billed usage; unknown usage is not silently assumed zero.

records.title: Implement guarded adaptive optimization experiments
records.description: Enable A/B or shadow mode, automated rollback when quality degrades, confidence thresholds and human review policy.
acceptance: No policy is promoted by token savings alone; reproducible evaluation gate documents acceptance.

records.title: Secure operations, reliability and supply-chain governance
records.description: Productionize local-first evidence services and gateway interfaces while minimizing credential, dependency, tenancy and deployment risks.
acceptance: No model or tool gets unrestricted cross-tenant secrets or untrusted cache content.
Staged rollout, signed/pinned artifacts and incident recovery are documented and tested.

records.title: Implement release quarantine and expedited security patch policy
records.description: Support flexible 1/3/7/14/30/90-day holdback by component risk; default 14 days routine and 30 days high-risk, security fixes expedited after review.
acceptance: Lockfiles/image digests, SBOM, advisory checks and provenance gates tested; no age-only trust assertion.

records.title: Document and exercise multi-instance deployment and data retention
records.description: Design local and clustered Redis/Valkey/SQLite-compatible storage, backup restore, key rotation, privacy deletion and service boundaries.
acceptance: HA/concurrency/load tests report tested configurations; no production multi-tenant claims without isolation proofs.

records.title: Harden access, secrets, audit and budget enforcement
records.description: Integrate secret manager abstractions, key scoping, least privilege, encryption in transit, outbound allowlists, request auditing and spending alarms.
acceptance: Threat model blocks secret exfiltration via prompts, logs and cross-agent caches; deny cases independently tested.
